title: land appends a land.step row per step and a land.end row, and warns when the item has no work rows
goal: bl_land.py: backlog.py land records through ql_capture.record('ops', event='land.step', item, step, exit, ms) one row per step it runs and a land.end row (item, exit, total ms, lane) at every end, stop or success; a land of an item whose branch commits left no work rows (ql_capture work rows for the item, claim/done) prints one 'warning: ...' line naming the item and the missing capture hook, exit unchanged; a capture failure never changes land's exit. Tests in the NEW file _tools/test_ops_land.py: -k ops_land_rows plants a land through the existing land test seams and reads the rows; -k land_warns_when_item_has_no_work_rows plants an item without work rows.
